撤销本应用的账号引用并清理本应用保存的凭据。不会撤销供应商授权、退出原生客户端或: Revoke this app's account reference and remove credentials saved by this app. Provider authorization, native client sign-in, and the source file will remain unchanged.
将保存此供应商的固定或轮换策略、会话亲和与冷却设置。已有任务继续使用原预算与发送: Save this provider's fixed or rotating account policy, session affinity, and cooldown settings. Existing tasks keep their original budget and dispatch ledger.
仅导入本次选定文件中的 API key 或 OAuth 凭据，绑定到所选供应商。: Import only the API key or OAuth credentials in the selected file and bind them to the selected provider. Native client authentication files are not supported by this import.

凭据刷新已完成；额度仍以有效来源证据为准。: Credentials refreshed. Quota is still determined by valid source evidence.
账号已保存；授权与额度状态以列表中的实际证据为准。: Account saved. Authorization and quota status depend on the actual evidence shown in the list.

OAuth 需要合法应用注册及推理授权。当前面板仅导入明确授权的 OAuth 凭: OAuth requires valid app registration and authorization for inference. This panel only imports explicitly authorized OAuth credentials. PKCE sign-in and SIWC subscription inference are not yet integrated.

请在对应原生客户端完成登录或更新授权。: Complete sign-in or update authorization in the corresponding native client.
此账号尚无可用的授权刷新接口，请重新授权或等待客户端接入。: This account has no available authorized refresh interface. Reauthorize it or wait for client integration.

旧凭据的安全存储清理待完成；当前账号引用仍有效。: Cleanup of old securely stored credentials is pending. The current account reference remains valid.
会话亲和在账号可用时保持绑定；失败、限流或可信额度耗尽后按策略处理，轮换复用原任: Session affinity keeps the same account while it is available. Failures, rate limits, and verified quota exhaustion follow the policy. Rotation uses the original task budget.
使用不含邮箱或凭据的短名称。别名会保存在本地元数据中。: Use a short name without an email address or credentials. The alias is saved in local metadata.

凭据只保留在当前表单内存中，提交结束、取消或离开页面时清除，不提供预览。: Credentials remain only in this form's memory and are cleared when submission finishes, you cancel, or you leave the page. No preview is provided.

本地撤销尚未完成，请刷新列表。: Local revocation has not completed. Reload the list.
本地引用已撤销；安全存储清理待完成，可重试本地撤销。: The local reference is revoked. Secure storage cleanup is pending; you can retry local revocation.
本地引用已撤销，已清理本应用凭据；供应商授权与客户端登录未退出。: The local reference is revoked and this app's credentials have been removed. Provider authorization and client sign-in remain active.
额度未知；未收到有效证据，不能视为零额度。: Quota is unknown because no valid evidence has been received. Unknown quota does not mean zero quota.

请检查别名、供应商、凭据类型和有效期。别名不能包含邮箱或凭据。: Check the alias, provider, credential type, and expiry. The alias cannot contain an email address or credentials.
账号本地引用不存在，请刷新列表。: The local account reference does not exist. Reload the list.
绑定的供应商不存在或当前不可用。: The bound provider does not exist or is currently unavailable.
账号元数据存储暂不可用，操作已阻断。: Account metadata storage is temporarily unavailable. The operation was blocked.
账号安全存储暂不可用，请检查桌面集成与系统凭据服务。: Account secure storage is temporarily unavailable. Check desktop integration and the system credential service.
安全存储中的账号凭据缺失，请重新授权。: The account's securely stored credentials are missing. Reauthorize the account.
账号已被其他操作更新，请刷新后重试。: Another operation updated this account. Reload and try again.
此账号的本地引用已撤销。: This account's local reference has been revoked.

本次尝试已派发或结算，不能重复发送。: This attempt has already been dispatched or settled and cannot be sent again.
账号凭据版本已变化，请重新选择。: The account's credential version has changed. Select the account again.

客户端尚未提供已授权的刷新接口，请在原生客户端重新登录。: The client has not provided an authorized refresh interface. Sign in again in the native client.
凭据刷新失败或超时，账号进入受控冷却。: Credential refresh failed or timed out. The account is in a controlled cooldown.
凭据刷新受到限流，请等待冷却结束。: Credential refresh was rate-limited. Wait for the cooldown to end.
凭据已失效，请在对应客户端重新登录或重新授权。: Credentials are no longer valid. Sign in again or reauthorize in the corresponding client.
额度证据缺失、过期或与账号不匹配，未采用该额度。: Quota evidence is missing, expired, or does not match the account. This quota was not applied.
文件选择已过期或已使用，请重新选择具体文件。: The file selection has expired or has already been used. Select a specific file again.
所选文件不符合账号导入格式或大小限制。: The selected file does not meet the account import format or size limit.
